title: Canyon Analytics Form 8-K voting agreement
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K
Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.
On May 7, 2026, Canyon Analytics entered into a voting agreement with its founder and Chief Executive Officer. The founder beneficially owns approximately 38% of the outstanding common stock and agreed to vote those shares in favor of the proposed board slate and governance amendments at the annual meeting.
